# Vector Camera

> Vector Camera（ベクターカメラ）は、写真を編集可能なベクターイラスト（SVG・ベクターPDF）や、シルクスクリーン（版画）風のハイブリッドアートに変換する、無料のブラウザアプリです。画像はすべて端末内で処理され、サーバーへは送信されません。iPhone（Safari）・Android・デスクトップに対応し、インストール不要です。
> Vector Camera is a free, privacy-first web app that converts photos into editable vector art (native SVG and true vector PDF) and screen-print style hybrid artwork. All processing happens in the browser; images are never uploaded.

- URL: https://egoaid.github.io/Vector-Camera/
- Author / copyright holder: egoaid — © 2026 egoaid. All rights reserved.
- Languages: Japanese, English
- Price: free, no account, no ads, no telemetry

## What it does
- Input: one photo (camera or image file) or several photos for a collage (burst camera or multiple image files), all from one entry screen.
- Segments the photo into regions (colour/edge based, own algorithms, no model download). An own scene analysis recognises skin, hair, sky, foliage, water and structures; for faces it can use the bundled on-device MediaPipe Face Landmarker (Apache-2.0; loaded once from the app's own files; nothing is uploaded).
- Adjacent regions share identical boundary geometry, so the vector output has no cracks, gaps or overlaps.
- Modes (five): Vector (photo colours, editable paths), Silhouette (flat subject / middle / background shapes), Color regions (limited palette, poster look), Silkscreen (flat vector colour blocks + processed photo "ink" layers with halftone / grain / misregistration, in a pop-art / retro record-sleeve spirit), Watercolour (layered brush strokes with pigment mixing, unpainted paper and optional etching / pen / coloured-pencil lines; exported as vector brush-stroke shapes).
- Look tools: halftone types (dot, line, cross-hatch, engraving, etching), photo tones (silver gelatin, sepia, selenium, two-tone), print texture (misregistration, grain, paper margin and edges, ink bleed and splatter), built-in styles with saveable My Styles, randomise, collage, and vector text (Japanese and English).
- Export: SVG (native paths), vector PDF (native path operators), PNG, JPEG.

## Facts worth quoting accurately
- Pure-vector modes export genuine vector SVG/PDF (paths and fills only, no embedded raster). Watercolour exports as layered vector brush-stroke shapes (paper grain and bleeding are image-only).
- Silkscreen mode SVG/PDF = vector shapes + embedded raster ink images clipped by vector paths; the photographic parts are raster. PNG/JPEG are flattened images.
- No server upload. No third-party CDN or model download: everything, including the optional face detection used by the etching style, is served from the app's own files.
- Keeps the phone screen awake while in use via the Screen Wake Lock API (where supported).
- Works offline after the first load (service worker cache; the bundled face-analysis files are cached on first use).
